reason: My buyers have never asked to see their house before it's built, and I sell on photos of finished homes. I bill cost-plus, so any $1,500 goes onto the homeowner's bill, and I'd have to talk them into agreeing to it.
objection: I wouldn't pay for it myself, and the homeowner would have to agree to the charge. Nobody has asked for this, so I'd be adding a line item to solve a problem they don't feel.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner of mine asking for it unprompted, or a free first project that visibly helped me close a signed job or avoid a change order.
